_comment: Example of what the operating LLM writes AFTER the human confirms an elicited why. Fact grace_ids are placeholders — resolve them with intent_query.py --facts '*' before running intent_apply.py. Fictional Northwind content.

principles.name: no_discretionary_exception_without_a_recorded_reason
principles.statement: A payment above the standard schedule is only allowed when an accountable person records the reason before the money moves.
principles.applies_when: Any process that lets a case leave a standard path and pay more than the schedule.

rationale.name: courier_exception_requires_supervisor_rationale
rationale.summary: The overnight courier exception requires all three conditions AND a Claims Supervisor rationale before paying above schedule so that goodwill exceptions cannot creep in unrecorded; the rationale is what makes the exception auditable.
rationale.constraint: The settlement schedule in Endorsement C-14 is fixed; adjusters cannot change it.
rationale.stakes: Without the recorded rationale, exception payments become untraceable and the schedule stops meaning anything.
rationale.controlling_reason: Auditability of every payment above schedule.
rationale.subordinate_reasons: Consistency between adjusters; fewer disputes with the shipper.

counterfactuals.name: adjuster_discretion_goodwill_exception
counterfactuals.description: Let the adjuster grant a goodwill exception on their own judgement.
counterfactuals.demanded: No supervisor rationale; adjuster decides case by case.
counterfactuals.why_rejected: Untraceable exceptions; inconsistent outcomes; the memo explicitly says do not invent a goodwill exception.
